shortcut_name: mean-1.5 with binary tiers triggers bipartite-graph recognition
evidence: Both models immediately derive that the mean condition gives a sum of 3: "the only way sum=3 is one endpoint is 1 and other is 2" and "one is 1 and the other is 2," then identify it as "exactly checking graph bipartiteness".
affordance_in_statement: Each amplifier requires a power tier assignment of either 1 or 2; for each critical connection, the stability metric is the arithmetic mean of the power tiers assigned to its two endpoints; a connection is stable if and only if its stability metric is exactly 1.5.
removal_suggestion: This is the intrinsic mathematical structure of the task, so it cannot be removed without changing the problem.
